headline: Apollo Micro Systems: SEBI Takeover Regulations Disclosure Filed
sum: Apollo Micro Systems Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, signalling a material acquisition event triggering mandatory acquirer/target disclosure protocols.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure indicates the acquirer has crossed a mandatory threshold (typically 25% or above) and must now comply with open offer and other post-acquisition governance requirements; this establishes the formal regulatory gating point for the transaction.
detail: The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 was filed with NSE. This regulation mandates that any acquirer crossing specified shareholding thresholds must disclose material facts within two business days. The specific identity of the acquirer, consideration amount, and number of shares acquired are not disclosed in the headline but would be contained in the formal disclosure document filed with the exchange.
